Three waiting periods have expired with no landlord update and the tenant reports the proofing still undone (event-010, event-017, event-018). I chased the landlord with a two-option ask and a hard reply-by of 5pm Tue 16/09/2025 (ACT-1), updated the tenant with that time and interim hygiene/safety advice without promising a date (ACT-2), put the case on hold Waiting for Landlord (ACT-3) and recorded the scope gap and safety checks (ACT-4). The case now waits on one named party for a landlord-owned decision (RTE-LANDLORD), so it finishes as request_info rather than an escalation; if 16/09 passes with no reply, the next step is a referral to the property manager.

facts.statement: Tenant reported rats outside and inside the kitchen, including beneath the sink, on 14/08/2025, after four days away; a small dog lives at the property and there are no access restrictions.
Agency acknowledged the report to the tenant the same day and said landlord approval would be sought before works (14/08/2025).
Landlord was asked on 17/08/2025 whether Northbridge should arrange works or he would use his own contractor; he replied asking for a call and gave no written approval.
On 18/08/2025 the agency recorded that the landlord would arrange the works directly and asked him for an expected completion date; no contractor, scope or date was recorded.
Tenant was told on 18/08/2025 that the landlord would arrange works and that he or his contractor might contact them about access.
On 01/09/2025 the tenant reported pest-control visits ongoing and the openings beneath the kitchen sink still unsealed.
On 07/09/2025 the tenant said pest control attended and removed its equipment, and that separate contractors were expected the next day for the wall area; on 08/09/2025 nobody attended.
Three automated waiting-period expiries were recorded (07/09, 08/09, 11/09) with no landlord update and no evidence the proofing is complete.
No landlord spend cap, standing instruction, pest-control report, diagnosis, quote or completion evidence is on file; a history search returned no such record.
Tenant prefers phone contact and offered to report any rearranged appointment.

conflicts.description: Scope of the outstanding proofing is inconsistent: openings beneath the kitchen sink (tenant, 01/09) versus contractors working on the wall area (tenant, 07/09); the landlord separately recalls a Dec 2024 record saying filling external openings may not be feasible.

red_flags.description: Key facts rest only on recollection and untrusted tenant/landlord accounts: no pest-control report, diagnosis, entry route, contractor name or completion evidence is on file, and the landlord's Dec 2024 'may not be feasible' recollection is unverified.
red_flags.action_taken: Recorded in ACT-4; documentary evidence requested from the landlord in ACT-1.

input.message:
Re: 14 Mosswold Crescent, Brindlewick — rat activity in the kitchen (reported 14/08/2025, event-001).

On 18/08/2025 we recorded that you would arrange the pest treatment and proofing directly and asked for an expected completion date (event-007). No completion date or confirmation has reached us since.

What the tenant has reported since:
- 01/09/2025: pest-control visits ongoing; openings beneath the kitchen sink still not blocked (event-010).
- 07/09/2025: pest control attended and removed its equipment; separate contractors expected the next day for the wall/openings (event-014).
- 08/09/2025: nobody attended to fill the openings (event-017).

We hold no written pest report, no diagnosis of the entry route and no evidence that any opening has been sealed. The repairing obligation clock (s.11 Landlord and Tenant Act 1985) has been running for four weeks with rodents reported inside the kitchen.

Please reply by 5pm on Tuesday 16 September 2025 with either:
(a) the contractor, the agreed scope and the date your proofing work will be completed, and a copy of the pest-control report; or
(b) your written authority for Northbridge Lettings to instruct a pest-control contractor to inspect, identify the entry route and quote for proofing — we would send you the quote for approval before any work starts.

If we have no reply by that time we will refer the case to the property manager for a decision; we will not instruct any contractor or incur any cost without your written approval.
